facts.statement: It lived during the Late Cretaceous, from the middle Coniacian to the middle Santonian stages, in the northern Gulf of Mexico and the Western Interior Basin of North America.
facts.quote: known from the Late Cretaceous (middle Coniacian to middle Santonian stage) of the northern Gulf of Mexico and the Western Interior Basin of North America

facts.statement: The genus was originally named by Cope in 1874 under the name Clidastes planifrons.
facts.quote: Plesioplatecarpus was originally named by Cope in 1874 as Clidastes planifrons

facts.statement: The name Plesioplatecarpus was established by Takuya Konishi and Michael W. Caldwell in 2011.
facts.quote: The name Plesioplatecarpus was erected by Takuya Konishi and Michael W. Caldwell in 2011

facts.statement: The type specimen is the nearly complete skeleton AMNH 1491.
facts.quote: It is known from the holotype AMNH 1491, a nearly complete skeleton

facts.statement: The new genus was created because phylogenetic analysis showed Platecarpus planifrons was distinct from the genus Platecarpus.
facts.quote: to incorporate Platecarpus planifrons, which was found to be distinct from Platecarpus in a phylogenetic analysis

facts.statement: It belongs to the family Mosasauridae and the subfamily Plioplatecarpinae.
Its parent group is the tribe Plioplatecarpini.

rejected.statement: Plesioplatecarpus is an extinct genus of plioplatecarpine mosasaur.
rejected.quote: Plesioplatecarpus is an extinct genus of plioplatecarpine mosasaur
